description: DELETE Microsoft.Edge/configurations at api-version 2026-03-01 never deletes: ARM rejects the RP response ('Failed to create HTTP response as per the API specification ... Consider to retry operation with api-versions ''') and 2025-08-01 behaves the same. 2026-06-01 accepts the delete (provisioningState 'Deleting'). Pin DeleteConfiguration to 2026-06-01.
